matches.preview: The model favours Manchester United at 71%, with Hull City at 11% and a draw at 18%. Both sides return after the summer break with sharply contrasting recent form: United claimed five wins from six matches while Hull secured one victory alongside three draws and two defeats. When the two teams previously met, United dominated those encounters, winning three times and drawing twice in their five most recent meetings. The forecast leans toward goals, with over 2.5 at 60%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型預測 Manchester United 勝率為 71%，Hull City 為 11%，平手為 18%。兩隊在夏季休賽期後回歸，但最近狀態形成鮮明對比；Manchester United 在六場比賽中贏得五場，Hull City 則是一勝三平兩負。兩隊過往交手中，Manchester United 佔據優勢，在最近五次交手中贏得三場、平手兩場。預測傾向於進球較多，比賽進球數達三球或以上的機率為 60%。

matches.preview: This opening encounter is finely balanced, with the model rating Everton slight favourites at 43% to Crystal Palace's 29%, while the draw sits at 28%. Both sides finished last season inconsistently, each recording four defeats and two draws in their final six matches. The recent head-to-head record favours Everton: three wins and two draws across the last five meetings, including a 2-2 stalemate from those final fixtures. The total-goals picture leans slightly under 2.5 at 52%, suggesting a tighter opening fixture than the recent scoring between them would indicate.
matches.preview_zh: 這場首場對陣勢均力敵，模型將Everton列為小幅看好方，勝率為43%，相對Crystal Palace的29%，而平局機率為28%。雙方上賽季成績起伏，各自在最後六場比賽中錄得四場敗績和兩場平手。近期交手紀錄對Everton有利：過去五場對戰中贏得三場並平兩場，包括最近一次的2-2平局。進球總數傾向略低於2.5球，佔52%，暗示這場首場對陣會比雙方最近的進球表現更加緊湊。

matches.preview: This looks finely balanced, with the model finding little to separate the sides at 36% for Ipswich and 35% for Sunderland. Ipswich has just returned to the Premier League from the Championship where recent form was mixed. Sunderland's last campaign was inconsistent, ranging from a 0-5 home loss to Nottm Forest to victories over Chelsea and Everton. Ipswich are unbeaten in their recent meetings against Sunderland. The model leans toward a low-scoring game, with under 2.5 goals at 55%.
matches.preview_zh: 這場比賽看起來勢均力敵，模型認為雙方差別不大，Ipswich 的勝率為 36%，Sunderland 的勝率為 35%。Ipswich 剛從英冠回到英超，近期表現不一致。Sunderland 上賽季表現起伏不定，從主場 0-5 負於 Nottm Forest 到戰勝 Chelsea 和 Everton 都有。Ipswich 近期對陣 Sunderland 保持不敗。模型傾向低進球比賽，少於 2.5 球的機率為 55%。

matches.preview: The model favours Nottingham Forest at 41% against Leeds United's 31%, with draws at 29%. Both sides return to this level having shown comparable substance in spring form: Forest registered three wins mixed with draws, whilst Leeds matched that victory count but finished with a heavy 3-0 away defeat. Their head-to-head record across recent meetings shows no established dominance. The model expects under 2.5 goals at 53%, indicating a defensively cautious encounter unlikely to produce a high-scoring result.
matches.preview_zh: 模型看好Nottingham Forest勝率為41%，對陣Leeds United勝率為31%，平局佔29%。兩隊回到此水平，春季表現體現了相近的實質：Forest取得三場勝利並混有平局，而Leeds也取得相同勝場數，但最終以客場0:3慘敗收場。兩隊近期對戰紀錄中未見明確的優勢方。模型預期比賽進球少於2.5的機率為53%，顯示這將是一場防守謹慎的比賽，不太可能出現高比分結果。

matches.preview: Brentford edges the model's calculation at 44%, though this remains an open contest with Tottenham's away record and historical head-to-head advantage keeping the visitors at 30%. Brentford's home form at the end of last season was patchy, mixing draws and defeats against stronger sides. Tottenham won away at both Aston Villa and Wolves and have historically held the edge in meetings between these teams, though their most recent clash finished goalless. The probability leans slightly towards the over at 57% for more than 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: Brentford在模型計算中略佔優勢，勝率達44%，雖然Tottenham客場戰績與歷史對戰優勢使客隊維持30%勝率，比賽仍屬開放局面。Brentford上賽季末主場表現起伏不定，與更強隊伍的交手中混合了平局與敗績。Tottenham曾客場擊敗Aston Villa和Wolves，在兩隊歷史對戰中一向佔優勢，雖然最近一次交手以無進球作收。超過2.5球的概率略傾向57%。
